# Local frontend libraries

These files are vendored locally so the application does not need a CDN at runtime.

- Bootstrap 5.3.0 — `bootstrap/` — MIT
- Font Awesome Free 6.4.0 — `fontawesome/` — Icons CC BY 4.0, fonts SIL OFL 1.1, code MIT. The SVG/JavaScript build is used, so no webfont files are required.
- Chart.js 4.5.1 — `chartjs/` — MIT
- Quill — existing files `../quill.js` and `../quill.snow.css`

License texts are stored beside each library.
